headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds rallied past the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win in a one-sided contest. The Seattle Mariners shut down the New York Yankees in a low-scoring affair, securing a 1-0 victory.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Milwaukee Brewers due to a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Seattle Mariners with left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox have placed Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants with an abdominal strain, while Trevor McDonald has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox with right elbow inflammation. James Outman has been placed on the 7-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers with a concussion, and Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Pittsburgh Pirates with left hip inflammation.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade, while the Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise to 13-1 Victory Over Marlins**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win in a one-sided contest. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a pair of home runs and six RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking a disappointing end to the matchup. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense, while Matthew Liberatore struggled on the mound for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in 1-0 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins, handing their opponents their first loss. Chase Burns was instrumental in the win, leading the Reds' pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
